gaps: A representative, current full cash cost per completed door conversation was not established. The Nickerson figure is a labor-only scenario published in 2006; vendor rate cards price attempted or verified doors, not conversations.

No source measured volunteer door attempts, completed contacts, dials, and costs in the same 2026 candidate campaign population. Do not divide one vendor's price by another guide's contact rate as though it were observed.
No reliable office-specific multiplier across the five requested offices was established. Shared observations are not five independent office estimates.
Cash cost of a volunteer door or phone shift remains UNKNOWN, not zero; transport, lists, materials, platform and supervision vary.
USPS $0.26 is only EDDM Retail postage for an eligible flat; printing, design, labor, and route preparation are not priced by this source. A representative all-in mail-piece cost remains UNKNOWN.

No defensible general digital cost per thousand impressions, typical event cost, or fundraiser net yield was established. A CPM definition or a committee receipt total is not a price or net event yield.

State House candidate-hour figures are 2008 self-reports for the first week of October among contested major-party lower-house candidates in 18 states. They are subgroup means, not national challenger/incumbent schedules. State Senate, city council, county, and U.S. House weekly hours remain UNKNOWN.

gapEvidence.reason: USPS price is postage only; design, print, preparation, and addressed-mail rates are not established.
Official source defines average cost per 1,000 impressions but supplies no political-campaign price; merged action catalog has no distinct paid-digital purchase action.
Transaction-level disbursement fields do not establish a representative cost per event or office.
Receipts and expenditures are separately recorded; these pages do not provide matched typical net event yield.
